build_gaussiandiffusion_scheduler: build a GaussianDiffusion scheduler with a linear beta schedule and MSE loss type
create_training_losses: create training losses for a diffusion model at a given timestep with optional noise
run_p_sample_loop: run a DDPM sampling loop to generate samples from random noise using the model
run_ddim_sample_loop: run a DDIM sampling loop to generate samples faster with a configurable eta noise parameter
calc_bpd_loop: calculate the full variational lower bound in bits-per-dim for evaluating diffusion model quality
